cards.title: JavaScript Foundations for Vue
cards.content: Vue.js relies heavily on modern JavaScript (ES6+). Understanding concepts like arrow functions, destructuring, and the reactivity model is crucial for building robust Vue components.

content.question: Which syntax correctly extracts the 'name' property from a user object using ES6 destructuring?

content.text: In Vue 3, to update an array immutably or trigger UI updates efficiently, methods like [blank] create a new array with all elements that pass a test implemented by the provided function.

cards.title: Array Transformation in Vue
cards.content:
In Vue templates, you often need to transform lists of data. map() and filter() are your best friends.

const activeUsers = users.filter(u => u.isActive);
const userNames = users.map(u => u.name);
